title: Quasi-isomorphism for local finite-free model
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pc-flat-model-finite-free-shortening and a point t ∈ U, there exist V ≤ U and a complex P supported in [0,d] with finite-free terms, with quasi-isomorphisms eQ : (V → U)^*Q ⟶ P and eP : P ⟶ (V → U)^*C such that eQ ≫ eP = (V → U)^*e.

proof.text:
restrict to an affine neighbourhood of t and set M = coker(Q^{-1} → Q^0).
The finite-free terms of Q are quasi-coherent, hence so is M, and M is finitely
presented. At each stalk, C is bounded and flat in [0,d], so it has Tor amplitude
[0,d]. The bounded-above free complex Q is K-flat at each stalk, and its
quasi-isomorphism to C implies negative tensor cohomology vanishes. Tag 0653
then gives flatness of M at every stalk. Thus the affine module associated to M
is finitely presented and flat, hence finite projective by Tag 00NX. Shrink
around t until M is finite free. No quasi-coherence of C is assumed.
Define P by the quotient truncation of Q: zero in negative degrees, M in degree
zero, and Q in positive degrees. It vanishes above d and all terms are finite free.
The quotient Q → P is a quasi-isomorphism because Q has no negative cohomology.
Since C^{-1} = 0, the chain map e kills the image of Q^{-1} → Q^0 and factors
through P. This factor is a quasi-isomorphism by two-out-of-three. Open restriction
is exact, so the same argument and comparison hold on the shrunken neighbourhood.
The witnesses are constructed simultaneously; no assertion concerns an arbitrary P.
Retain the quotient map eQ from the restricted Q to P. The degree-zero cokernel universal property and identity maps in positive degrees give eQ ≫ eP = (V → U)^*e. Thus this theorem constructs a compatible quasi-isomorphism factorization, strictly stronger than the existing construction theorem.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_finiteFree_quasiIso {T : Scheme.{u}} (U : T.Opens) (C Q : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ) (hCge : C.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hCle : C.IsStrictlyLE d) (hCflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) (hQle : Q.IsStrictlyLE d) (hQfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (Q.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)))) (e : Q ⟶ C) (he : QuasiIso e) (t : T) (ht : t ∈ U) : ∃ (V : T.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U) (P : CochainComplex V.toScheme.Modules ℤ), (t ∈ V ∧ P.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE d ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ, Nonempty (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r))))) ∧ ∃ (eQ : ((Modules.pullback (T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj Q ⟶ P) (eP : P ⟶ ((Modules.pullback (T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C), QuasiIso eQ ∧ QuasiIso eP ∧ eQ ≫ eP = ((Modules.pullback (T.homOfLE hVU)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map e
